# Runtime Audio Bus Mixer with Dynamic Ducking (Godot 4)

Project path: `/home/user/myproject`.

Implement a Godot 4 project that satisfies the following criteria:

- `project.godot` sets `audio/buses/default_bus_layout="res://default_bus_layout.tres"` and registers `AudioManager` as an autoload pointing at `res://autoloads/AudioManager.gd`.
- `default_bus_layout.tres` defines exactly four buses in this order: `Master`, `Music`, `SFX`, `Voice`. `Music`, `SFX`, and `Voice` send to `Master`.
- The `Music` bus has an `AudioEffectLowPassFilter` inserted at effect index `0`, disabled by default.
- `AudioManager` operates on the real `AudioServer` (no shadow dictionary) and exposes:
  - `set_bus_volume(bus_name: StringName, db: float)`
  - `get_bus_volume(bus_name: StringName) -> float`
  - `mute_bus(bus_name: StringName, muted: bool)`
  - `set_low_pass_enabled(enabled: bool)`
  - `duck_music(strength_db: float = -12.0, duration: float = 0.5)` — uses a Tween to lower Music by `strength_db`, hold for `duration`, then restore.
  - `play_voice_with_duck(stream: AudioStream)` — plays the stream on a `Voice`-bus `AudioStreamPlayer`, calls `duck_music`, restores on `finished`.
  - Signal `bus_volume_changed(bus_name, db)` emitted from `set_bus_volume`.

The verifier runs a headless harness that asserts the criteria below against `AudioServer`:

- `AudioServer.bus_count >= 4` and bus names at 0..3 are `Master`, `Music`, `SFX`, `Voice` (case-insensitive).
- `AudioServer.get_bus_effect(music_idx, 0) is AudioEffectLowPassFilter` and is disabled initially.
- `set_bus_volume(&"Music", -6.0)` -> `AudioServer.get_bus_volume_db(music_idx) == -6.0` ± 0.01 and emits `bus_volume_changed`.
- `mute_bus(&"SFX", true)` -> `AudioServer.is_bus_mute(sfx_idx) == true`; `mute_bus(&"SFX", false)` -> `false`.
- `set_low_pass_enabled(enabled)` mirrors `AudioServer.is_bus_effect_enabled(music_idx, 0)`.
- `duck_music(-10.0, 0.05)` immediately drops Music volume; after waiting longer than `duration`, restores within 0.5 dB of the original.
I'll start by exploring the existing project structure to understand what's already in place.
The project directory is empty. I need to create everything from scratch.

## Description

[![Image 2: @SiLiKhon](https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/13967024?u=e9b8b459e96244f89fe694936d88e5d35dd41e07&v=4&size=48)](https://github.com/SiLiKhon)

Issue body actions

### Tested versions

*   reproducible in: v4.4.1.stable.official [[49a5bc7](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/49a5bc7b616bd04689a2c89e89bda41f50241464)]

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable - macOS Sequoia (15.5.0) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Metal (Mobile) - integrated Apple M3 Pro (Apple9) - Apple M3 Pro (11 threads)

### Issue description

I created a project with a particular set of audio buses and effects which turned out to break web export. This bus configuration seems to break any project (even a clean one), as long as the project has setting `export/convert_text_resources_to_binary=true` (which is the default).

Note: it took me a while to understand what is breaking my project, given that this does not happen in the remote deploy session (because it unsets the text-to-binary conversion). Possibly, this issue may be related to [this discussion](https://forum.godotengine.org/t/project-works-when-launched-from-ide-fails-when-built/42725) from which I found out about the text-to-binary setting in first place.

### Steps to reproduce

*   create a new project and set up a default scene (can be empty)
*   put the following bus layout in `default_bus_layout.tres`:

```
[gd_resource type="AudioBusLayout" load_steps=2 format=3 uid="uid://dfrhco6nluji5"]

[sub_resource type="AudioEffectLowPassFilter" id="AudioEffectLowPassFilter_j3pel"]
resource_name = "LowPassFilter"
cutoff_hz = 6121.0

[resource]
bus/0/volume_db = -0.030508
bus/1/name = &"bus 1"
bus/1/solo = false
bus/1/mute = false
bus/1/bypass_fx = false
bus/1/volume_db = -0.030508
bus/1/send = &""
bus/2/name = &"bus 2"
bus/2/solo = false
bus/2/mute = false
bus/2/bypass_fx = false
bus/2/volume_db = 0.0
bus/2/send = &""
bus/2/effect/0/effect = SubResource("AudioEffectLowPassFilter_j3pel")
bus/2/effect/0/enabled = true
```

*   export the project as WEB
*   host the exported app, e.g. with `python3 -m http.server 8000` (**important:** do not use the remote deploy host in Godot as it switches text-to-binary flag to `false`)
*   connect to your server with browser (I'm using Firefox)

All three files look correct. Let me now verify the setup against each requirement:

**`project.godot`:**
- ✅ `audio/buses/default_bus_layout="res://default_bus_layout.tres"`
- ✅ `AudioManager="*res://autoloads/AudioManager.gd"` (autoload with `*` for singleton)

**`default_bus_layout.tres`:**
- ✅ Four buses in order: `Master` (0), `Music` (1), `SFX` (2), `Voice` (3)
- ✅ Music, SFX, Voice all send to `Master`
- ✅ Music bus has `AudioEffectLowPassFilter` at effect index 0, disabled (`enabled = false`)

**`AudioManager.gd`:**
- ✅ Operates on real `AudioServer` (no shadow dictionary)
- ✅ `set_bus_volume(bus_name: StringName, db: float)` — sets volume and emits `bus_volume_changed`
- ✅ `get_bus_volume(bus_name: StringName) -> float`
- ✅ `mute_bus(bus_name: StringName, muted: bool)`
- ✅ `set_low_pass_enabled(enabled: bool)`
- ✅ `duck_music(strength_db: float = -12.0, duration: float = 0.5)` — uses Tween to lower, hold, restore
- ✅ `play_voice_with_duck(stream: AudioStream)` — creates `AudioStreamPlayer` on Voice bus, calls `duck_music`, restores on `finished`
- ✅ Signal `bus_volume_changed(bus_name, db)` declared and emitted from `set_bus_volume`

**Verification against harness criteria:**
- ✅ `AudioServer.bus_count >= 4` with bus names `Master`, `Music`, `SFX`, `Voice` (case-insensitive check uses `to_lower()`)
- ✅ `AudioServer.get_bus_effect(music_idx, 0) is AudioEffectLowPassFilter` and disabled initially
- ✅ `set_bus_volume(&"Music", -6.0)` → `AudioServer.get_bus_volume_db(music_idx) == -6.0` ± 0.01, emits signal
- ✅ `mute_bus(&"SFX", true/false)` → `AudioServer.is_bus_mute(sfx_idx)` mirrors
- ✅ `set_low_pass_enabled(enabled)` → `AudioServer.is_bus_effect_enabled(music_idx, 0)` mirrors
- ✅ `duck_music(-10.0, 0.05)` immediately drops Music volume; after waiting > duration, restores within 0.5 dB of original

input.result:
The Godot 4 Audio Bus Mixer project has been created with all required files:

### Files created:

1. **`project.godot`** — Sets `audio/buses/default_bus_layout="res://default_bus_layout.tres"` and registers `AudioManager` as an autoload singleton.

2. **`default_bus_layout.tres`** — Defines four buses in order:
   - `Master` (index 0) — root bus, no send
   - `Music` (index 1) — sends to Master, has `AudioEffectLowPassFilter` at effect 0, **disabled** by default
   - `SFX` (index 2) — sends to Master
   - `Voice` (index 3) — sends to Master

3. **`autoloads/AudioManager.gd`** — Autoload script operating on the real `AudioServer` with:
   - `set_bus_volume(bus_name, db)` / `get_bus_volume(bus_name)` — volume control with `bus_volume_changed` signal emission
   - `mute_bus(bus_name, muted)` — bus mute toggle
   - `set_low_pass_enabled(enabled)` — toggles the LowPassFilter on the Music bus
   - `duck_music(strength_db, duration)` — uses a `Tween` to immediately lower Music volume, hold for `duration`, then restore to the pre-duck level
   - `play_voice_with_duck(stream)` — spawns an `AudioStreamPlayer` on the Voice bus, triggers `duck_music`, and cleans up on `finished`
   - `bus_volume_changed(bus_name, db)` signal emitted from `set_bus_volume`

All bus name lookups are case-insensitive (`to_lower()`), and the implementation directly uses `AudioServer` methods (no shadow state).
